intended_object: The canonical anti-equivalence between cosimplicial objects in C and simplicial objects in Cᵒᵖ, i.e. (Fun(Δ, C))ᵒᵖ ≌ Fun(Δᵒᵖ, Cᵒᵖ) (from the docstring and name).
explanation: CosimplicialObject C is SimplexCategory ⥤ C and SimplicialObject Cᵒᵖ is SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ ⥤ Cᵒᵖ. The general equivalence (A ⥤ B)ᵒᵖ ≌ Aᵒᵖ ⥤ Bᵒᵖ, which Mathlib provides as Functor.opUnopEquiv, specializes to exactly the stated equivalence, and the definition uses it directly. The type is correct and the construction is the canonical one. The definition holds for an arbitrary category C. Its content is specifically about (co)simplicial objects, so specializing the general equivalence does not make it too narrow.
